entity.description: A room: a direct message between two or more users (CrtDirect, one per set of users, reused), a private group (CrtPrivate), a public room (CrtPublic) or a room bound to a record (CrtRecord, one per record). Who may read and join beyond its members is visibilityEnumId: members only (CrvMembers), any user (CrvUsers), or the users who may see the record (CrvRecord, asked of the service the theme value STRT_RECORD_VISIBLE_SERVICE names). lastEventSeq is the number of the room's last event; the next event takes the next number.

field.name: roomName
field.description: Empty for a direct room, which shows the other members' names

field.name: directKey
field.description: For a direct room, its members' userIds sorted and joined with commas, so the room of a set of users is found and reused

field.name: retentionDays
field.description: How many days the room keeps its events; empty for always. The daily job clean#ChatRetention deletes the older ones.

field.name: archivedDate
field.description: An archived room is read only

field.name: lastMessageSeq
field.description: The last message of the room's main timeline, for the room list

field.name: lastMessageActorId
field.description: The actor of the last message (an external actor has no lastMessageUserId)

field.name: federationEnabled
field.description: Y: remote users of a native endpoint (XMPP, Matrix) may join the room; empty or N: only local users and the connectors mapped to it (ChatRoomBridge). Local users reach any room they belong to with an XMPP or Matrix client either way.

field.name: agentsReadExternal
field.description: Y: the room's agent members get the messages of external actors too (the room's explicit policy; an encrypted room never). Empty or N: agents get only local users' messages.

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Any user may read and join
Users who may see the record may read and join

entity.description: An actor in a room, now (leftDate empty) or before: a local user (userId, the actor's own, kept here for the reads by user) or an external actor of a bridge (userId empty; C1). A member reads up to lastReadEventSeq; the events after it are unread. notificationLevelEnumId says what counts and notifies: every message (CnlAll), mentions only (CnlMentions) or nothing (CnlNone). A muted room (isMuted) counts and notifies as CnlMentions and the client plays no sound for it. An agent member (CmrAgent) is a service user whose agentRef names the service the room's messages are handed to (the Assist port's entry point; no model runs in the framework).

field.name: userId
field.description: The local user of a local actor; empty for an external actor

field.name: agentRef
field.description: For an agent member, the service that receives the room's messages (deliver#AgentMessage calls it)

field.name: lastReadEventSeq
field.description: Never empty: the unread views compare the events with it

entity.description: An event of a room's timeline, numbered per room (eventSeq: 1, 2, ... in the order they happened). A message (CetMessage) has its content in contentJson: {body (safe HTML), mentions [userId], attachments [{chatAttachmentId, attachmentSeq, fileName, contentType, fileSize}], records [{entity, id}], forwardOf (a forwarded message: {senderUserId, senderName, sentDate, body, bodyText}, made by the server), poll ({question}: the poll's rows are ChatPoll)}; replyToEventSeq quotes another, threadRootEventSeq puts it in that message's thread. An edit (CetEdit, editsEventSeq the message, contentJson the new body and mentions), a reaction (CetReaction, relatesToEventSeq the message, contentJson {key}), a redaction (CetRedaction, relatesToEventSeq the message or reaction it removes), a pin (CetPin, contentJson {pinned}), a membership change (CetMembership, contentJson {action: join, leave, add, remove, role; userId; roleEnumId}) and a system row (CetSystem: created, renamed, topic, archived) are events too, so the timeline is what the WebSocket pushes. The fields after sentDate are kept on a message for the reads: its current text (bodyText, for search and snippets), the last edit, the redaction (whose content is then cleared), the pin, its thread's reply count and last reply, and its link previews. clientRef is the sender's own reference of a message, so a send that is tried again is answered with the message it made.

field.name: senderUserId
field.description: The local user who sent it; empty for an external actor's event

field.name: senderActorId
field.description: The actor who sent it (C1): a local user's actor, or an external actor of a bridge

field.name: threadLastEventSeq
field.description: The thread's last reply that stands

field.name: clientRef
field.description: The sender's reference of the message, ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$

field.name: linkPreviewJson
field.description: The previews of the message's links, a JSON list of {url, title, description, siteName} (fetch#LinkPreviews), or {"removed": true} once the sender removed them

entity.description: An actor mentioned in a message (or in its edit), so the mention counts and the Mentions filter are one find. A redaction removes its rows. userId is the local user of a local actor.

view-entity.description: The unread messages of a member, per room in one query: the messages (not redacted) from others after the member's read marker. Find it by userId with leftDate empty, select chatRoomId and unreadCount (grouped by room). get#UnreadCounts and find#Rooms read it.
The mentions of a member after the member's read marker, per room in one query. Find it by userId with leftDate empty, select chatRoomId and mentionCount (grouped by room).

entity.description: A file of a message, stored as a DbResource under dbresource://chat/(room)/(attachment)/(file name). upload#Attachment makes the row before the message is sent (eventSeq empty); send#Message gives it the message's eventSeq and its place (attachmentSeq).

A poll: a message (CetMessage, content.poll) whose options are ChatPollOption and whose votes are ChatPollVote. Anonymous: who voted is not shown. Multiple: a user may choose more than one option. It closes at closesDate, or when its creator or a moderator closes it (closedDate). A redaction of the message removes it.
An option of a poll, with the count of its votes.
An actor's vote for an option of a poll; vote#Poll replaces a user's votes. userId is the local user of a local actor.
The preview of a link (get#LinkPreview), kept a day, or an hour for a link that could not be read (failed Y), so a link posted again is not fetched again. Text only: no image is kept or loaded.

field.name: urlHash
field.description: The SHA-256 of the URL, hex

entity.description: A user's place in their chat changes feed (ChatUserChange): lastChangeSeq is the number of the user's last change; the next change takes the next number, with this row locked as append#Event locks ChatRoom.lastEventSeq, so a change is committed before a later number is given. purgedChangeSeq is the last number clean#UserChanges took out of the feed: a client whose cursor is older reads everything again (reset). Made on the user's first change.

A change of what a user's chat client keeps, numbered per user (changeSeq: 1, 2, ... in commit order; ChatUserState), so a client offline for a while reads what changed in all its rooms from one cursor (the chatChanges transition, get#UserChanges). New messages are not changes: a room's newest event is its lastEventSeq, which get#UserChanges answers per room (heads). What is: the user's membership of a room (joined, left or taken out, role), a room's details or members (room), the user's own settings and read marker in a room, a message changed after it was sent (an edit, a reaction, a redaction, a pin, its link previews or poll: message, eventSeq the message's), and a room's retention (retention, eventSeq the last event deleted: everything up to it is gone). A change replaces the user's earlier change of the same kind, room and (for message) eventSeq, with a new changeSeq, so the feed holds one row per thing that changed, not one per write. changeJson is the kind's detail (record#UserChange). clean#UserChanges removes changes older than chat_changes_keep_days.

A user's presence and status (design-drawers-commons §1.8), set from the account menu: online, away, do not disturb or invisible, a status text with an emoji, and a time it clears at. The client's heartbeat keeps lastSeenDate (offline after a few minutes without one) and lastActiveDate (away after the CHAT_AUTO_AWAY_MINUTES preference without input). Others see invisible as offline. lastPresence is the presence last published on the userStatus topic, so a change is published once. Do not disturb silences the client's toasts and chat sounds; the notifications are still recorded and counted.

field.name: inCall
field.description: Set by the call services (later)

entity.description: Who acts in chat: a local user (CakLocal, userId; agents are local service users) or an external actor of a bridge (CakExternal, chatExternalUserId), never both, each unique within its kind. An external actor has no login and no UserAccount. A local actor's chatActorId is its userId, made on first use (get#LocalActors); an external actor's is sequenced with the prefix XA.

A connector account or federated network: one row each. typeEnumId is the network; adapterName picks the ChatBridgeAdapter registered through moqui_core::extension that serves it (empty: the network's code). configJson holds the provider account's settings and secrets, encrypted; inboundTokenHash is the SHA-256 (hex) of the token an adapter gives ingest#Event. statusId: CbsConnected, CbsNotConnected (its rooms show "not connected" and keep their local timeline), CbsDisabled (no deliveries, no input). sendsPerMinute caps the deliveries a node sends to it (empty: the adapter's limit). webhookPublicKey is the public key the network signs its webhooks with (an SMS bridge's configJson publicKey, copied by store#Bridge and, for a bridge saved before, at start) and webhookToleranceSeconds its window: not secret, so they are all of the configuration an edge node's replicated copy has (plans/Edge-Node.md §5.4).

A connector's mapping of a Moqui room to a room or conversation elsewhere (externalRoomId), in from it, out to it or both (directionEnumId). An external room has one active mapping (thruDate empty) per bridge; delivery rows keep this mapping's id. A native endpoint addresses the Moqui room itself and has none. A link to an external room grants no rights.

A person on a bridge's network, unique on the bridge and their id there (externalUserId: for a native endpoint the JID or Matrix ID). linkedUserId is a verified puppet link to a local user: provenance, never permission to act as that user.

A local event and its external counterpart: the bridge (a connector's mapping, chatRoomBridgeId, or a native endpoint), the external room and event id, unique together even across mapping changes, with where it began (originEnumId: CeoInbound came from the network, CeoOutbound was sent there), its original time and protocol metadata. It dedupes input, suppresses echoes and maps edits, reactions and deletes to their target. lastEditOriginDate is the original time of the last edit applied, so an older edit that arrives late changes nothing.

An authenticated batch from a bridge (the Matrix application service transaction contract), stored before it is acknowledged: the bridge and its transaction id are unique together, so a batch sent again does nothing. batchJson is the bounded batch, outcomesJson each item's outcome by its itemId (accepted, duplicate, echo, waiting, stale, rejected with a reason code). statusEnumId: CbiReceived (stored, not yet worked), CbiWaiting (items wait for their target's mapping), CbiDone. Kept 30 days, longer than a provider retries.

One local event to one destination (a connector's mapping), written in the event's transaction and unique on the event and mapping. idempotencyKey goes with every attempt; dependsOnDeliveryId is the delivery of the message an edit, reaction or delete needs first. statusEnumId: CdsPending, CdsAccepted (remoteEventId is the network's id), CdsFailed (permanent, or out of attempts: visible, with an authorized retry), CdsUncertain (an attempt whose result was lost to a destination that cannot dedupe: it may or may not have arrived). A worker holds a row while it sends (leaseOwner until leaseExpiresDate). The row stays after the event's content is purged, as a dedupe tombstone, and keeps no message text.

field.name: encrypted
field.description: Y: end-to-end encrypted, set when the room is made (create#Room encrypted) and never turned off

field.name: encrypted
field.description: Y: contentJson.encrypted is the event's Megolm ciphertext (the m.room.encrypted content: algorithm, sender_key, ciphertext, session_id, device_id)
